name: The Office Rooms Demo
short_description: Multiple Ending walking simulator inspired by Backrooms, Pools and Severance. Explore, discover, escape? Immerse in the unsettling depths of the Office Rooms. No monsters or jump scares, just the fear of dark and endless spaces, getting lost, and liminal space alternate reality and conspiracy.
